d: South Africa have found a way to win the big moments, and Temba Bavuma has been at the heart of it. After leading the Proteas to the World Test Championship title, Bavuma is making another statement against Australia, with his 179 setting up a crushing victory in the Test series. But beyond the runs and results, what is it about his captaincy that has helped South Africa rise when the pressure is on? Rupha Ramani looks at the man leading South Africa's latest charge in Test cricket.
